name: 4.2-kiloyear event
short_desc: A period of severe regional drought is associated with the late third millennium BCE, though its extent and social effects remain debated.
date_note: Uses the article’s explicit approximate onset of 2200 BCE, rather than converting the event’s name relative to the viewer’s present. The episode lasted beyond this plotted point; a globally synchronous drought and direct links to societal collapse remain disputed.
notes: New source-linked entry. The Wikipedia introduction, date evidence and article identity received an initial editorial check; independent claim-specific source review remains open.
